subject.title: Feishu: @mention not recognized in group when multiple bots share the same group (open_id app-scoped mismatch)

question: Which Feishu identity matching strategy should OpenClaw support for multi-bot group mentions when WebSocket mention open_id is scoped differently from the receiving app's bot/v3/info open_id?
rationale: The bug is real at the source level, but the existing PR's union_id fallback conflicts with the reporter's API finding and with current-main code, so automation cannot choose the permanent Feishu identity contract safely.

options.title: Rewrite around proven identity resolution
options.body: Require a current-main replacement or rewrite that proves the stable identifier or cross-app open_id collection strategy through probe/startup/message parsing tests and real Feishu evidence.

options.title: Accept union_id fallback with proof
options.body: Proceed with the union_id approach only if Feishu API proof shows the bot identity and mention payloads actually provide a stable union_id for bot entities in this setup.

options.title: Defer Feishu multi-bot mention support
options.body: Keep the current limitation documented and close the linked PR if maintainers decide the platform identity behavior is too ambiguous for now.

recommendation.title: Rewrite around proven identity resolution
recommendation.body: Require a current-main replacement or rewrite that proves the stable identifier or cross-app open_id collection strategy through probe/startup/message parsing tests and real Feishu evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned on the linked PR and already reviewed the current-main identity-surface conflict.
